headline: Front-Line Ownership Battles Gather Force
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has become the liveliest front, posting six ownership events in the latest two-hour watch and 23 across the day, with casualties accelerating on both sides and holdings split six Warden to three Colonial. Deadlands has also quickened, recording three fresh events and 18 in 24 hours; its ledger stands at nine Colonial bases and two Warden-held. Stonecradle remains under close observation, with two events in the latest two hours, 15 for the day, and heavy, accelerating losses amid an eight-to-one Warden advantage. Stlican Shelf is quieter at the moment—no event in two hours—but its 43 daily changes remain the largest ledger in the packet, with seven Warden and two Colonial bases. Callahan’s Passage has likewise gone still in the latest watch after five events over 24 hours, while all ten bases remain Warden-held. Godcrofts records ten daily events and mixed control, though none in two hours. Elsewhere, most sectors report no recent ownership movement, leaving these contested fronts the chief watchpoints for the next day.
